description.value: The Consortium's presence in the dwarf galaxy, run from two pressure modules and a walled yard sited eleven kilometres downwind of the nearest terraces, at a distance that was agreed rather than chosen. It is the acknowledged authority on terminator settlement and on working relationships that have to survive an eleven-year relief cycle. Forty-six people are on its books and six are on the station at any one time.
Edina stalna postojanka konzorcija v pritlikavi galaksiji.

notes.value: Staff whose tours overlap by a fortnight at handover refer to one another, permanently and without irony, as the fortnight.
